title: Plant Pathway Atlas: Modernizing MapMan, PlantCyc, and ggPlant for Systems Biology and Cross-Species Omics Projection
description: A high-information-density pathway visualization package and omics projection framework for plant biology. Modernizes classic MapMan functional BIN hierarchies and PlantCyc metabolic networks into deterministic, measured-text vector diagrams with cross-species orthology connectivity (Arabidopsis, Rice, Maize, Tomato, Soybean, Yeast, and animal models) and ggPlant spatial cellular context.
